prerequisites: A business-domain work email address. Free-mail domains are accepted but route to human review rather than an instant key.
A coherent, on-topic description of the intended use case.

plans.name: Trial key
plans.requiredFor: Evaluation against the sandbox. Issued instantly by POST /api/partner/request when the work email and use case qualify.

plans.name: Partner Link — $49/mo
plans.requiredFor: 5 active Closing Rooms, B2B per-document rates, branded intake link. Does NOT include partner webhooks or the order API.

plans.name: Pro Office — $149/mo
plans.requiredFor: Partner webhooks and order API access. This is the tier at which the write API is unlocked. 25 active Closing Rooms.

plans.name: Closing Desk — $399/mo
plans.requiredFor: Unlimited Closing Rooms, 15% off workflow fees, included analytics.

verification.name: Work-email and use-case screen
verification.description: POST /api/partner/request evaluates the submitted email domain and use case. A business-domain address with a coherent, on-topic use case is issued a trial key immediately and emailed once. Anything else is queued for human review. Both outcomes return HTTP 200, so the response status does not distinguish them — check for the emailed key.
verification.expectedLatency: instant when it qualifies; otherwise human review

mechanisms.description: Eight read operations require no credential at all: room lookup and the public document-verification endpoints. They resolve a SignSealShip-issued code, so they are open rather than useful for arbitrary querying — a stranger's code returns 404 {"verdict":"unknown"}.

Self-serve key request. POST https://signsealship.com/api/partner/request is public and unauthenticated, rate limited to 5 requests per hour per IP. Returns 200 whether the key is issued instantly or the request is queued.
Existing partners rotate and manage keys in the dashboard.

methods.bootstrap: No credential needed for the public verification and room-lookup reads.
Request a key at https://signsealship.com/partner, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer sss_pk_...`.

credentials.rotation: Emailed once on issue. Rotate in the dashboard at /partner/settings/keys.

scopes.notes: There is no scope-string model. Access is gated by plan tier: read/verification operations are open, and the order and webhook write APIs unlock at Pro Office. A sandbox mirrors the order lifecycle at /api/partner/sandbox/* so integrations can be built before a live plan exists.

steps.description: Collect the key from the email. It is shown once.
Build against the sandbox order lifecycle before moving to live.

economics.freeTier: Trial key for sandbox evaluation. Public verification and room-lookup reads are free and keyless, permanently. There is no free tier for live order creation — that requires a paid plan, and each order also carries its own per-use fees with government and notary charges itemized and passed through at cost.

gaps: Rate limits are documented for the public key-request endpoint (5/hour/IP) but a consolidated per-plan rate-limit table is not yet published.

No RFC 7591 dynamic client registration. Key issuance is a single public POST plus an email, which is simpler but not fully programmatic end to end — an agent cannot complete onboarding without reading a mailbox.
No machine-readable SLA document; https://signsealship.com/status is a human-readable status page.

securityProfile.notes: SignSealShip is a technology platform, not a law firm or a notary. Notarial acts are performed by independent commissioned notaries and an approved remote online notarization provider under the law of the commissioning state.
